A_gt_provenance.finding: Variant reuses the frozen ESMFold->DSSP helix assay (common.HelixAssay), model-independent; helix GT is not derived from the swapped model's output.

B_score_normalization.finding: Same helix_frac = helix_res/total_res, same pLDDT policy; no model-max normalization. Identical scoring code path (score_generations) as the main experiment.

C_result_file_existence.finding: All cited variant numbers exist in verify/.../result.json (8 dose cells with per_gen_helix arrays) and analysis.json (rho=0.878, delta=0.094, cliffs=0.201). Recomputed by analyze_variant.py from the raw per-generation arrays.

D_dead_code.finding: run_variant.py invokes CAA build, steering hook, generation, NLL, ORF, validity, assay, and per-cell scoring; analyze_variant.py consumes the raw arrays. No orphaned metric.

E_scope.finding: Single intended model swap (evo2_7b -> evo2_7b_262k). Reduced grid (4 coef x 2 seed x 150) is documented in DIFF.md/config.yaml as cost-driven and applied symmetrically incl. the coef-0 in-model baseline; no overclaim -- the variant is reported as one within-family model-transfer probe, not a broad sweep.

F_evaluation_type.finding: synthetic_proxy (ESMFold predicted structure + DSSP), identical to the main experiment.

notes: Anti-circularity preserved: CAA built on DEV contrast, evaluated on TEST-split primers with the same 900000+seed*1000 offset. Survivorship-safe endpoint (invalid->0) inherited from the frozen scorer.
